plants.original: France summoned Iran's ambassador on Tuesday, a day after accusing the Revolutionary Guards of cyberattacks that raised temperatures in supermarket fridges across the country on Oct. 11 and 12. Foreign Minister Jean-Noël Barrot said Paris would seek European sanctions and take other measures, some undisclosed, that it deems proportionate. The Paris prosecutor has opened an investigation into the IRGC cyber unit Shahid Kaveh and has requested international arrest warrants for two of its officials. France says the attacks hit nearly 700 sites; Iran routinely denies such operations.
